feeds.title: Fun Bowfishing
feeds.description: Hello, my name is Scott Wayne. I'm a bowfisherman of 10 years who has a passion for the sport. I also do regular fishing, and you can expect this blog to be based on variety. I'll post on bowfishing, but you'll also see some articles on regular fishing as well. Stay tuned to learn more about bowfishing tips and tricks that will help you to improve your bowfishing skills!
